column1: # Wayback captures of the General Debate delegation files (sessions 79 to 81), from the Wayback CDX on 2026-11-04
# Written by T-P23-1 (docs/10 B-852). Columns: session, file, capture timestamp, length. Only captures with a positive CDX length are listed:
# a capture with a negative length (for example 80/hn_es_0, 80/gt_es, 80/hr_en) answers HTTP 404 on replay. 16 of 16 positive-length captures sampled served a PDF.
# The CDX answers "Temporarily Offline" at times (retry after 20 s); the availability API (archive.org/wayback/available) misses captures the CDX lists.
# Added by T-P23-2 (docs/10 B-853): the 80th-session captures whose CDX length is negative but which the replay serves through a redirect to another capture.

# Columns: session, file, CDX timestamp, bytes served after the redirect, timestamp of the capture served (use it with pnpm archive --capture). 26 negative-length captures answer 404 (ad_en ad_fl ad_fr ae_en bh_ar bh_en bw_en ch_en ch_fr cy_el cz_en dz_ar ee_en gt_es hn_es_0 hr_en is_en lv_en mx_es_0 nl_en np_en nz_en om_ar ph_en sd_fl zw_en).
# A served size of exactly 5242880 bytes may be a truncated replay: compare with the live file before relying on it.
